**Coaching Note:**

Your knight on d5 can leap to c7 with check—this forces the king to f8 to avoid it. Then Qd8 is checkmate: the queen controls escape squares and the knight blocks f7. Before moving a piece under attack, always scan for forcing moves (checks, especially knight checks) that might win by force. This pattern—knight check + queen mate on the back rank—is worth memorizing.
